0022600193.text: Orlando (2-6, 12th in the East and 0-4 at home) comes in on a three-game losing streak, 3 games back in the Southeast, while Golden State (6-3, 2nd in the Pacific and 8th in the West) is riding a six-game winning streak. The Magic are missing Desmond Bane (illness), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and the Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), with Draymond Green (elbow inflammation), Gary Payton II (calf), and Gui Santos (knee) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, with the last meeting a 120-97 Golden State win over Orlando in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
